Title: Solar Power
Content: Solar power is usable energy that is generated from sunlight in the form of electric or thermal energy. Solar energy is captured in a variety of ways, the most common of which is solar panels. Solar panels are composed of photovoltaic cells that convert sunlight into electricity. The table provides details about the advantages and disadvantages of both black solar panels and blue solar panels.

A school district in Mississippi would like to install solar panels. They would like to rely less on power from the local power company. The district is trying to determine the best option for producing electricity from solar energy.
